newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Treasury's Evans applauds AIRC decisions.
newsitem.headline: Australia Treasury's Evans applauds AIRC decisions.

text.p: Australian Treasury Secretary Ted Evans said on Thursday that recent wage decisions by the Australian Industrial Relations Commission (AIRC) would contribute to better employment propects.

"(The commission), in the 'living wage' case and in considering the Transport Workers Award, have demonstrated a clear understnding of the importance of enterprise bargianing in achieving growth oriented outcomes," Evans said.
"In both cases the commission's decisions will contribute to better employment propects," Evans told a Australian Business Economists luncheon in Sydney.
